data_product_overview:
## About this dashboard
Prescribing costs vary significantly across therapeutic areas and prescribers, and understanding these variations is essential for medicines optimisation and financial governance. The Top 50 Paragraphs by Cost Prescriber Report in ePACT2 provides authorised users with a ranked view of the 50 British National Formulary (BNF) paragraphs that account for the highest prescribing costs for each prescriber.

This report enables practices, SICBLs, and commissioners to identify which therapeutic areas are driving expenditure and assess whether prescribing aligns with clinical guidance and cost-effectiveness objectives. Users can filter data by time period and prescriber, supporting targeted analysis and informed decision-making. The report also helps organisations monitor trends over time and benchmark performance against regional and national averages.

The aim of this report is to promote transparency and accountability in prescribing costs. It helps prescribers and commissioners identify opportunities for improvement, reduce unwarranted variation, and share best practice. While the report provides valuable financial insights, it should be used alongside clinical dashboards to ensure that cost-saving measures do not compromise patient care. Its intention is to generate discussion within local health economies, inform medicines optimisation strategies, and support equitable resource allocation across the NHS.
